tasks.label: Build + test on GPU
tasks.detail: Build all images, smoke test them, then export an ONNX model in the devcontainer and execute it in the runtime image. Requires the CUDA execution provider - a CPU fallback fails the run. This is the real gate; CI only builds and publishes.

tasks.label: Smoke test devcontainer on GPU
tasks.detail: Image checks only (single CUDA stack, torch linkage, ORT providers, venv inheritance) against the already-built devcontainer. Skips the build and the end-to-end run.

tasks.label: End-to-end on GPU
tasks.detail: Export a model with PyTorch in the devcontainer, publish the C# consumer, run it under the runtime image on CUDA. Uses already-built images.

tasks.label: Build images
tasks.detail: Build all six images. No tests.

tasks.label: nvidia-smi in devcontainer
tasks.detail: Confirm the GPU is visible inside the built image - the first thing to check when the CUDA provider goes missing.
